messages:
maya: Heads up — final ops checklist for Brooklyn Dev Night this Thu 6–9pm. Need quick signoff on swag qty, speaker start times, booth layout, and inbound lead routing.

joel: +1. Can we confirm booth footprint? Are we on the aisle by the entrance or the back wall?

maya: We're on the long aisle near the coffee station (booth B12). Corner-ish but mostly linear. Planning 2 high-top tables + demo laptop.

tariq: For staffing, I'd recommend 3 ppl at the booth at peak (6:30–8). I can do 6–7, lina can cover 7–9, joel can float. Ashley can handle teardown.

lina: Speaker update — my lightning talk slot is 7:10pm (10m), then panel at 8pm. Can you list the full speaker blocks so I can prep slides?

maya: Schedule: 6:15 doors + mix, 6:30 welcome + quick intros (2m), 6:40 demo (redwood quickstart) 15m, 6:55 lightning talk 1 (external) 10m, 7:10 lina 10m, 7:25 break + networking, 8:00 panel + Q&A 25m, 8:30 wrap.

ashley: Swag counts — final order arrived today. Physical: 200 tees (S:60 M:80 L:40 XL:20), 400 stickers, 150 tote bags, 150 promo cards with trial codes. Also 60 laptop webcam covers we kept separate for giveaways.

joel: Nice. Can we split tees across shift? Also want a small stack of stickers at the demo table.

maya: Yes. Packing plan: demo table: 30 stickers, 10 promo cards, 2 tees (L/M) for quick refs; main swag table: remaining tees, totes, webcam covers.

ops-bot: @maya shipping reminder — booth furniture pickup window Fri 10:00–12:00. You must confirm pickup by 18:00 Thu to avoid fees.

maya: Thanks ops-bot. Confirming pickup slot for Fri 10. Joel, can you be on site to receive?

joel: I can do Fri 10–11. I’ll add the event to my calendar.

shipping-bot: Shipping label created: HW-REDWOOD-BKN-0326. Carrier: LocalFreight. ETA to venue Fri 12:30. Tracking: https://track.localfreight/XYZ123 :package:

tariq: For lead capture: use QR code A for trial signups (utm=brooklyn_dev), QR code B for trial + demo scheduling. Which one do we use at the table vs speaker slides?

lina: Put QR A on stickers & table tent, QR B on slide footer and promo cards (so high-intent ppl can schedule).

maya: Routing: QR A => mailing list + 10% trial credit email (auto). QR B => calendly + internal slack notification to #inbound-leads with tag `bk-night` for followup. Ashley, can you monitor #inbound-leads at 8:30–9:30?

ashley: Yep I got 8:30–9:30. I'll triage demos for next week and assign to SDR queue.

joel: Quick note on demo laptop: please install model zip v2.1 and test run `./start-demo.sh --no-stream` before packing. Last time the nightly build caused lag.

tariq: I'll bring the laptop and binary on a USB. I'll also run the script in the office tonight and leave a log snippet on the shared drive.

maya: Packing list (short):
```
- 2x high-top tables (provided by venue)
- 1x demo laptop + charger + HDMI
- swag boxes (tees, stickers, totes, webcam covers)
- printed promo cards (150)
- 2x tablet stands + QR table tents
- power strip + extension cords
- name badges + sharpies
- floor tape + gaffer
```

lina: Do we need an HDMI adapter? I have USB-C -> HDMI and dongles if needed.

joel: Bring both USB-C and miniDP adapters. Venue AV can be flaky.

maya: On lead followup: cadence is 1) immediate thank-you email with trial code, 2) 2-day reminder for scheduling, 3) WA handoff to SDR after 1 week if no engagement. We'll use the same trial code block on the cards but unique batch id `BK0326-01` for tracking.

ashley: I'll create the `BK0326-01` code and load into promo system by EOD Wed.

ops-bot: Venue rules reminder — no open flame, no helium balloons, and vendors must finish teardown by 10:30pm.

maya: Thanks all. Last ask: can someone snap a short 30s B-roll of the booth after setup? We'll use clips for socials. Joel?

joel: Happy to. I'll record 6:15–6:25.

maya: Perfect — if no objections, consider this set. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

lina: :thumbsup:

joel: :thumbsup:

tariq: :thumbsup:

ashley: :thumbsup:

maya: Great — closing thread. Will post final logistics PDF in #events-assets and pin it.
